name: ATV (quad bike)

seo.title: ATV Quad Ride Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: ATV on Koh Lanta: 30 minutes on a closed track, an hour in the forest up to a sea viewpoint, or ATV plus mangrove kayak. From 1,200 THB, transfer included.

lead: Thirty minutes on a closed track, an hour on the forest trails up to a viewpoint over the sea, or an hour of ATV followed by an hour of kayak in the mangrove.

facts.label: Rides
facts.value: 30 min closed track, 1 hr forest and sea viewpoint, or 1 hr ATV plus 1 hr kayak

facts.label: Ages
facts.value: Passengers from 4, drivers from 6 with staff supervision, no children under 4

facts.label: Cancellation
facts.value: At least 24 hours ahead; later, half the ride is charged

options.label: 1 hour of ATV and 1 hour of kayak

steps.label: 30 min
steps.text: On a closed, secured track. The ride for a first try.

steps.label: 1 h
steps.text: On the forest trails, with the climb to a viewpoint over the sea.

steps.label: 2 h
steps.text: One hour of ATV in the forest, then one hour of kayak in the protected mangrove of Thung Yee Peng, with its monkeys and fiddler crabs.

included: Kayak and life jacket on the combined ride

beforeYouBook.children: No children under 4. Passengers from 4, drivers from 6 with staff supervision.
beforeYouBook.cancellation: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Later than that, half the ride is charged.

faq.a: From 6, with closer supervision from the staff. Younger children ride as passengers from 4. Under 4 cannot come.
The 30-minute track is for a first try. The one-hour forest ride gets you to the viewpoint. The two-hour ride adds the mangrove by kayak.

legacyText.title: ATV Quad Ride Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Every ride comes with a guide, safety gear and a hotel transfer. Open all year. Children can ride as passengers from 4 and drive from 6 with closer supervision from the staff.
legacyText.cardDescription: An ATV ride on the dirt tracks of Koh Lanta.
goodToKnow: No children under 4. Passengers from 4, drivers from 6 with staff supervision.
Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Later than that, half the ride is charged.
Closed shoes and clothes that can get dusty.
